title: Find ideas that work
subtitle: A 20-minute vidIQ routine
sections: Type your main topic; note volume and competition.
Open related keywords; pick 3 with medium competition.
Search outliers: small channels with one video far above their average.
Write down the question each outlier answers.
Same question, your answer, your proof.
Hook with the outcome in the first 2 seconds.
steps: Run the routine once this week.
